name: Minecraft x GTA V Passthrough
description: Play real Minecraft inside GTA V story mode: GTA's camera drives Minecraft's, GTA's ground becomes invisible blocks, and Minecraft is drawn into GTA's picture (blocks drawn by GTA itself), with what you do in one game happening in the other. Made by LowBacon.
contributors: Adam Grzegorzewski (EldenCraft: GPU frames, avatar layer, native blocks)
